name: Curse you, Entropia
source:
You play as Laniakea, our lovely giant galaxy supercluster. Converse with the Stargazers of Earth, and accompany them on their journey as they grapple with their great isolation.

[From [url=https://snekofspice.itch.io/curse-you-entropia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演拉尼亚凯亚，我们可爱的巨型星系超星系团。与地球上的观星者交谈，陪伴他们度过他们与孤独作斗争的旅程。

[来自[url=https://snekofspice.itch.io/curse-you-entropia]itch.io[/url]]
